Unit 407 · Bedroom
Flagged"One of the bedside light bulbs is not functioning."
Resolved
Bulb replaced and tested. The bedside fixture now powers on cleanly. We swapped the dead bulb for a matching warm-tone bulb consistent with the room's lighting design.
Resolved
Flagged"The blackout blinds are stuck and can't be rolled up."
Resolved
Blinds freed and re-seated. The blackout roller now travels the full height and holds at every stop. Tested through several full open/close cycles.
Resolved

Resolved
Coverings serviced and operating. The mechanism now opens and closes smoothly end to end. Verified on-site.

Unit 411 · Bathroom
Flagged"The bathtub fixture feels loose/wobbly and may require tightening or repair."
Resolved

Resolved

Additional · Flooring
Noted in file"Burnt patch on the carpet."
Resolved

Confirmations Requested
Flagged"Could you confirm whether the fireplace is currently operational or if a repair is scheduled?"
Confirmed
The indoor fireplace is decorative by design: it is a non-functional feature and not a working heat appliance. There is no repair pending because there is no mechanism to repair. It is staged purely as a design element. We're glad to add a tasteful in-listing note so guests have the same clarity.
Flagged"Please confirm that the indoor cameras have been removed. Hosts are not allowed to have security cameras… that monitor any part of a listing's interior."
Confirmed
All interior cameras have been removed. No device remains that captures any interior space. The original fittings were professionally installed and the remaining faceplates sit out of common view; nothing records or monitors the interior. We fully understand and support Airbnb's interior-recording policy and are glad to certify this compliance in writing on request.
Removed
Proactive disclosureExterior security cameras on the property.
Disclosed & compliant
Two exterior security cameras remain in place: one at the front entry and one at the garage door. Both monitor outdoor areas only, neither captures any interior space, and both are disclosed in the listing in accordance with Airbnb's camera policy. Placement photos available on request.
